content.summary: The refreshed comparison and gate preserve bounded search and review-only scope. Two targeted degree19 checks support the separate equality closure without rounding or a hidden symmetry assumption. No necessary revision or counterexample was identified. Frozen hashes match, and shared evidence commitments are unchanged; this is not final acceptance or a fresh worldwide literature search.

revisions.action: Checked the manuscript diff against the prior reviewed definition and graph interpretation.
revisions.result: The explicit actual-member maximum definition remains unchanged and resolved.

checks.scope: Refreshed frontier wording, parameter comparison and continuation gate.
checks.method: Compared the manuscript diff with FRONTIER_REFRESH.md, native browser observations, rank4 findings, general assessment, gate and prospective contract amendment; recomputed the support-bound comparison exactly.
checks.observation: The records distinguish retrieved upper 68 from absolute priority and retain stale-index, incomplete native-search and inaccessible SSRN full-text limitations. The gate authorizes remaining review, expressly reserving final audits/publication and leaving H27 integrity unresolved. PalomarArchive presence is no longer called endorsement. At least eight support points are needed because binomial(7,4)=35; the documented BHL expression 3(863/432)^8 exceeds 760 and increases with support, so it does not imply 67. Native observations are explicitly transcriptions, not authenticated corpus exports. These qualifications support the present bounded wording; they do not rule out unseen competing work.

checks.scope: Degree19 singleton-Y equality: a non-strict certificate must supply an actual equality implication.
checks.method: Independently encoded the seventeen written rows in Ysingle-equality-proof.md and checked all 794 literal traces, without importing a model or checker; verified the displayed stabilizer directly.
checks.observation: The right-hand sides sum to 48. There are 400 admissible traces: coefficient 0 only at M, and coefficients 1/2/3 on 350/35/14 others. The 394 excluded traces have the stated internal or literal-sunflower reason. Thus r=49 forces every positively weighted row tight, including d(3)-6=10. Permutation (1 3)(4 5) preserves P10 and M, transporting the implication to d(1)=16 by relabelling the whole family, without requiring family symmetry. This checks the finite coefficient and equality interface, conditional on the written universal row premises and exact internal assignment.

checks.scope: Doubled-P10 arbitrary-support isolation and final counting.
checks.method: Read doubled-P10.md and the complete-C5 synchronization argument; independently tested all 56 nonempty support traces of size at most 4 for the claimed two-block witness.
checks.observation: All 56 traces admit A,B with A∩B=A∩S=B∩S. For the ten traces that are P10 blocks, A=B is necessary; distinct outside centres still make the lifted members distinct, as the proof requires. Extra members containing a centre are handled separately by link isolation. Remaining members avoid both centres and the P10 support; two disjoint ones would form an empty-core sunflower with a prescribed cone, so H27 applies. Inclusion-exclusion gives 27+16+16-3=56 without double-counting the twenty prescribed members. Checks and source hashes are preserved under checks/round09/alpha/; no broad replay was run.
